notes.title: Palm Reading Premium just had a major update (2.2.0)
notes.content:
--- 2.2.0 ---
* 4K@120FPS
* Added Achievements.
* Game runs smoother now with more FPS.
* Changed the font to a more modern.
* Uses less memory and loads faster.
* Added 1 language: Japanese.
* Major game engine update.
* Graphics quality is a lot better.
* Other bugs fixed.

notes.title: Version 2 is out! Remade completely!
notes.content:
Version 2 is out.
1) Completely redesigned from scratch.
2) Supports both 32bit and 64bit.
3) Now is full of particles, effects and super polished.
4) Now up to 5 persons can be saved.
5) Living room multiplayer!
6) Export outcome to your email.
7) Many UI improvements.
8) Animation everywhere.
